title: Pan-Seared Red Wine Cabbage
description: A simple yet flavorful dish featuring the sweetness of red cabbage and the bold flavors of red wine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the thinly sliced cabbage and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until slightly caramelized.
Pour in the reduced red wine and stir to combine.
Add the silky soy sauce and tagine spice, stirring to combine.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
